title: Printer not responding
description: The department printer is not responding to print requests and shows an offline status.

title: Unable to access development server
description: I am unable to connect to the development server from my workstation. The connection worked previously.

title: Microsoft Teams login issue
description: Microsoft Teams is showing a sign-in error and I am unable to access my team conversations.

title: Request for VPN access
description: I have recently joined the project and require VPN access to connect to the corporate network.
resolutionNotes: VPN access was approved and enabled for the requester.

title: Password reset required
description: I am unable to log in because my password has expired and I need assistance resetting it.

title: Laptop running slowly
description: My laptop has become very slow when opening applications and switching between windows.
resolutionNotes: Temporary files were cleared and system performance was restored.

title: Access to SharePoint site
description: I need access to the project SharePoint site to view project documents and resources.

title: Outlook calendar not updating
description: Changes made to my Outlook calendar are not synchronizing across my devices.

title: Network connectivity intermittent
description: The network connection disconnects intermittently while I am working from the office.

title: Keyboard keys not working
description: Several keys on my external keyboard are not responding consistently.

title: Unable to connect to Wi-Fi
description: The laptop is unable to connect to the office Wi-Fi network while other devices are connecting successfully.

title: Adobe Acrobat installation request
description: I need Adobe Acrobat installed on my company laptop for processing project documents.

title: Database access request
description: I require read access to the project database for application troubleshooting and support activities.

title: Unable to send emails
description: Emails are remaining in the Outlook outbox and are not being sent to recipients.
resolutionNotes: Outlook profile was repaired and outgoing email synchronization was restored.

title: Request for second monitor
description: I require an additional monitor for my workstation to support development and monitoring activities.

title: Corporate password expired
description: My corporate password has expired and I am unable to access internal applications.

title: Desktop monitor not detected
description: The laptop is not detecting the external monitor connected through the docking station.
resolutionNotes: Docking station drivers were updated and the external monitor was detected successfully.

title: Request for SAP role access
description: I need the required SAP role assigned to access the transaction codes needed for my project.

title: VPN disconnecting frequently
description: The VPN connection disconnects every few minutes while accessing internal applications.

title: Teams microphone not working
description: The microphone is not detected when joining Microsoft Teams meetings from the company laptop.
